featured_reviews.name: Shailesh Sahasrabuddhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Came to know about this tour company from locals (word of mouth), mostly from Marathi spraking senior citizens. Explored with them available tours, decided to give it a try on Saputara 3 day tour (even through price/cost quote seemed very high at that time), mostly for pleasure of my elderly mother. It turned out to be hit and miss. Some things worked well, some didn't -

A) What worked well -

Many things/aspects -
1) planning,
2) their experience in travel industry,
3) payment,
4) communication from them during planning and actual trip,
5) mostly good food/meals throughout 3 days
6) decent good logistics and instructions,
7) reasonably good accommodation,
8) comfortable bus,
9) variety content during tour (places, activities),
10) mostly good care of senior citizen needs,
11) family/homely atmosphere throughout
12) Photo/Video capture and sharing
13) Going extra mile for satisfying some specific non standard needs of certain tourists (elderly/handicapped tourists).

I sincerely appreciate whatever tour owners did for all above.

B) What didn't work well (for us) -

1) Rude behavior by tour owners - 2 times they claimed and told us something that was absolutely contradicting with 10s of unbiased unrelated people (taxi drivers, market vendors, other tourists) told us and many our fellow tourists in our tour. In important aspects of tour from comfort and content perspective. Especially for physically challenged senior citizens. Had the tour owners accepted their fault honestly and politely, maybe we'd have excused them (yes, things happen, not everthing goes well, not everyone is perfect, understandable) but instead, the tour owners arrogantly kept insisting that they were right and what they did was correct and the son of owner was EXTRELEY ANGRY AND RUDE and STARTED ARGUMENT with me, YELLED at me, and accused me of spreading false information in the group when in reality i was merely communicating whatever reasons tour owners gave me in those 2 specific matters. i was not bad mouthing them or accusing them of any wrongdoing. How they behaved was absolutely unacceptable. Whatever misunderstanding they had, they could have discussed with me respectfully, worse, we'd have agreed to disagree and move on. But instead, the son (Sachin)  created a big scene there. Such a  shameful and unwarranted behavior. I hope they realize their mistake and avoid behaving such in future.

At the end of trip they were polite, we both had let go of that bad memory temporarily. But that bad  incident on last day morning ruined the whole experience for me honestly (left a big scar and long lasting bad taste in mind). i wish it didn't happen.

2) Price - In hindsight, considering content and service, the price we paid (cost of the tour) was EXORBITANTLY HIGH. During plannig, Google search AI indicated tour operators charging price range INR 5k to 15K per person but that varied as per content and service. I took a chance and gave them benefit of doubt for high cost when i decided to go with this tour, but in hindsight i don't feel it was worth.

In spite of unreasonable price, I'd have tolerated it and HAD the tour owners accepted their fault OR even if they had a respectfully discussed with me about the 2 issues where they felt they had disagreement, I'd have been okay and given them 4 stars, but since they didn't, i have to cut rating by 1 star for each point above (what didn't work well).

As usual, i have tried to be 110% honest and fair in my review above, everything i have said above is based on my expectations and experience and priorities. I am sure other tourists and even tour owners might have difference of opinion and that's fine.

Then for a day we moved to Coonoor IbexTapas property.. what a location!!! On the cliff almost overlooking tea gardens. It was managed by ladies… again absolutely homely feeling. The colourful flowers and trees around were heavenly feeling… we were actually in clouds. The 4 days holiday was really an amazing experience. Trelpro had arranged for an vehicle and driver.. Babu was a humble cooperative person. We will definitely do more trips with Trelpro since they understand the customers and deliver to the T. Kudos to Trelpro team!!

Thank you very much, Om! We are happy and satisfied.

Mr Om Bag and Mr. Mangesh are really good to help us right from planning the trip, currency exchange and visa formalities. So Everyone cheers to TrelPro.

Wishing you all the best

featured_reviews.name: Aruna Pai
featured_reviews.review_text:
As the tagline of Trelpro suggests "Make your trip exquisite",we do make our trips exquisite with the association of Trelpro. This expertise provides a more authentic & enriching cultural immersion experience.
All other arrangements namely flight bookings, hotels,vehicles booking etc were upto the mark as usual.👍We look forward to a continued association with Trelpro for our  upcoming trips to various states in India.

featured_reviews.name: neeta kakkar

Mangesh ji was is constant touch during our visit to Vietnam.Everything went so smoothly, from the transfers to the accommodation. We really appreciate it.Thanks!
